about: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, marketing, and export of generic formulations and branded products in India. The company provides tablets, capsules, injections, ophthalmic, liquid orals, softgel capsules, ointments, creams and gels, powder for injections, suppositories, ovules, pre-mix bag formulations, inhalers, and sprays and IV infusion.
